description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of six distinct emotional categories derived from speaker anonymization evaluation on emotional speech data, with each slice corresponding to one emotion and labeled with its percentage share of the total. The chart is divided into six segments: “Frustration” (25.1%, light blue), “Neutral” (23.1%, dark blue), “Happiness” (8.1%, light blue), “Excitement” (14.1%, red), “Sadness” (14.7%, orange), and “Anger” (14.9%, yellow). The percentages are explicitly labeled within each slice, and the chart includes a legend that associates each color with its respective emotion. The segments are arranged in a clockwise descending order of size, starting from the top with “Frustration,” followed by “Neutral,” “Excitement,” “Sadness,” “Anger,” and concluding with “Happiness” at the bottom right.
